title: Synopsys looks to work with Chinese AI labs to speed up chip design
key_facts: Synopsys is the world's leading maker of chip design software.
It is looking to help Chinese companies develop chips faster with an AI version of its tools.
It plans to partner with large language model builders in China.
It says it will work within Washington's tightening controls on AI and semiconductor exports.
Sub-headline: it forecasts $11.15bn revenue in FY27 as OpenAI and Amazon deals drive its AI push.
quote_evidence: Chip design software leader Synopsys is looking to help Chinese companies develop chips faster with an AI version of its tools by partnering with large language model (LLM) builders in China, saying it will work within Washington's tightening controls on AI and semiconductor exports.
why_it_matters_hint: US chip-design software firm eyes China AI labs under export controls.
notes: Nikkei is paywalled after the first paragraph; the sub-headline also says Synopsys forecasts $11.15bn revenue in FY27 as OpenAI and Amazon deals drive its AI push. Seeking Alpha and TradingView relay the report. GuruFocus calls it an 'announcement', which Nikkei's 'looking to' does not support, so not used. Lead only.
